verification_notes: NO CODE CHANGES: all 14 entries are still null/none. Verification was blocked because WebSearch returned 'session has used its web search budget (200 of 200)' on the first three queries (eco7, trav3, sec6). I did not scrape DuckDuckGo or Bing to get around a limit the user set. The DuckDuckGo test request also hit a CAPTCHA.
Nothing was coded at +2/-2 or with evidence_type programme/vote/record_in_office, so there was no strong claim to check and no URL to test for fabrication or dead links. The draft cites no sources.

Null checks by direct fetch: fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marine_Tondelier had no statement on any of the 14 items. It confirms she declared her candidacy on 22 Oct 2025, Les Écologistes designated her on 8 Dec 2025, and her candidacy depends on an internal referendum after the left primary failed in July 2026. fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nouveau_Front_populaire showed only section headings with no policy text. nouveaufrontpopulaire.fr failed with an SSL handshake error.

sec6, ecol6 and edu5 are the most likely to have real evidence (2024 NFP programme planks and party statements). They should be re-researched first. Even if found, a 2024 coalition programme counts only as party_line or programme evidence, and the edu5 split rule (replacing Parcoursup while keeping selection is not agreement) must be applied.
